job.title: Data Analyst - Agriculture
job.description:
The Company
Avocados Australia is a not-for-profit organisation representing the Australian avocado industry from orchard to consumer. It provides strategic leadership, advocacy, research, market development and practical services to help growers and the broader supply chain remain profitable, competitive and sustainable.

The Opportunity Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you will manage the end-to-end capture, validation, analysis and reporting of key avocado industry data. Working as part of a small team you will oversee Avocados Australia’s core data systems and build strong relationships with growers, packhouses, traders and other industry stakeholders across Australia and New Zealand.  
  • Collect weekly and seasonal dispatch and forecast data from packhouses, traders and industry bodies, including regular phone engagement with growers.
  • Manage reporting and produce accurate weekly, quarterly and annual industry reports
  • Validate data for completeness and accuracy, then analyse trends in production, supply, demand, volume and price
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, including migrating existing PDF reports into interactive formats
  • Prepare professional graphs, presentations, statistics snapshots and tailored reports that help stakeholders interpret industry data
  • Support project planning, milestone reporting, implementation and budget management for the industry data program
About You
This role would suit a capable analyst who enjoys taking ownership of data from collection through to reporting and can turn detailed information into practical insights for a broad industry audience.

We would like to hear from you if you offer:
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in data analytics, economics or a related discipline, backed by proven experience in a similar data collection and analytics role
  • The position requires advanced Excel skills, including the ability to produce clear graphs and reports
  • Strong Power BI capability, including medium to high-level DAX, with experience building and maintaining interactive dashboards
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL, including querying, inserting, updating and altering data
  • Excellent attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data validation, completeness and accuracy
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and deliver projects with sound planning and budget awareness
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to identify useful data sources and explain findings clearly
  • You will have the opportunity to use your interpersonal skills to gain cooperation from growers, industry partners, consultants and internal stakeholders
  • High level of organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple activities concurrently, prioritise work and meet deadlines.
A background in economics or commodity markets would be valuable, while experience with a not-for-profit, member-based organisation or exposure to rural and regional communities would also be well regarded.

Why this Role?
This is a hands-on role where your work will help people across one of Australia’s leading horticultural industries make better decisions. You will join a friendly, close-knit team, gain exposure to a wide range of industry data and have room to grow your skills.

The role offers flexible start and finish times, and onsite parking. For a confidential discussion, please call Mark Turner on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Transport Scheduler - Grain & Logistics
job.description:
The Company

Our client is a well-established and respected agribusiness operating across grain and logistics services. They play a critical role supporting growers and customers through efficient, compliant and reliable transport operations. With a strong focus on safety, service and continuous improvement, the business offers a supportive team environment and long-term career opportunity.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Transport Manager, this role is central to the day-to-day coordination of transport operations. You will be responsible for scheduling and allocating trucks in line with customer requirements and National Fatigue Laws, while working closely drivers and the broader transport administration team.
This is a highly engaged, detail-driven role where no two days are the same. You will liaise closely with drivers, customers and internal stakeholders to ensure orders are planned, communicated and delivered efficiently. There is also scope to contribute to improving systems, processes and transport outcomes as the business continues to evolve.

About You

You may already be working in a transport scheduling or logistics coordination role, and ideally you would have a passion for the grain industry and/or Australian agriculture. You may even come from a broader agricultural background with a different skill set, and be ready to step into a more specialised scheduling position.

We would be open to speaking with you if you match the above, and have also:
  • Experience in transport scheduling, logistics or a similar coordination role
  • An understanding of compliance requirements, ideally including fatigue management
  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to deal with drivers and customers daily
  • A calm, practical approach in a fast-paced operational environment
Why This Role

This is an excellent opportunity to join a stable and growing agribusiness where your contribution is visible and valued. You will work closely with an experienced team, gain exposure to end-to-end transport operations and play a key role in keeping the business moving.

To discuss this opportunity in confidence, please contact Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701 or apply via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Chief Executive Officer
job.description:
The Company
Established in 1914, Holstein Australia is the country’s largest dairy cattle breed association and a recognised leader in registration, classification and genetic improvement services. Its Herdbook and Appendix contain records for more than two million animals, supported by around 40,000 new registrations and 30,000 classifications each year.

Representing approximately 900 members, Holstein Australia helps dairy producers improve profitability through world-class information, services and community.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Chair and Board, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) will take full responsibility for the day-to-day leadership and management of Holstein Australia. This is a visible, hands-on executive role with a clear mandate.

Working collaboratively with the Board, the CEO will shape strategy, vision and operational plans while leading a small, committed team. Externally, the successful person will be an accessible and credible representative for members, dairy producers, breed organisations, commercial partners and the broader agricultural sector.

Key Priorities
  • Lead all operational matters and create clear accountability across the organisation
  • Partner with the Board to develop and implement strategy, policy and measurable and achievable operational plans
  • Improve financial resilience, diversify of revenue and reduce reliance on volatile live-export income
  • Increase member engagement, service utilisation and confidence through stronger communication
  • Build organisational capability, support the team and address current resourcing priorities
  • Represent Holstein Australia at member activities, industry events and stakeholder forums
  • Manage change associated with structural, regulatory and market developments, including the potential merger
  • Maintain effective governance, budgeting, risk management and Board reporting
About You
You will be a credible and energetic senior leader who combines strategic judgement with the willingness to stay close to operations, members and industry. Commercially minded and relationship-driven, you will be confident and have experience working with a Board.

You may already be an experienced CEO, or a senior general manager or executive ready to step into your first chief executive role. Direct dairy experience will be highly regarded but is not essential; applications are encouraged from adjacent agricultural, livestock, genetics, member-based or industry organisations where you have built stakeholder trust and delivered commercial and organisational change.
  • Senior leadership experience with responsibility for organisational performance
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, performance analysis, reporting and revenue development
  • Experience working with a Board and a sound understanding of governance
  • Proven stakeholder engagement, communication and representation capability ideally in a member based organisation
  • Success leading people, change and organisational improvement
  • A practical, collaborative and accountable leadership style
  • Willingness to travel nationally and maintain a strong presence with members and industry
To Apply
For a confidential discussion, please contact Ryan Hoiberg or David Jackson at Rimfire Resources on 1300 380 701. To apply, submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant leadership, commercial and stakeholder experience.

Rimfire Resources specialises in agribusiness recruitment and is managing this executive search on behalf of Holstein Australia. All applications and enquiries will be treated in strict confidence.

job.title: Grains Buyer
job.description:
The Company
Our client is an industry leader in the manufacture of high-quality stockfeed products, supplying customers across Victoria and Southern New South Wales. With a multi-site feed mill network, strong operational capability and a reputation built on safety, quality and consistency, this Australian-owned agribusiness continues to invest in its people, systems and assets to support long-term growth and strengthen its market position

The Opportunity
Working closely with the Grains team leader, you will be responsible for the end to end management of grain contracts and grain procurement, with direction and support to purchase the required raw materials to ensure ongoing production across all facilities. You will be directed regarding approved suppliers and pricing elements to successfully negotiate and purchase products, and then be responsible for overseeing all relevant documentation and contract management.
In this role you will:
  • Negotiate and manage all commodity contracts, from execution to payment and conclusion
  • Manage internal grain inventory levels at each site tracking raw material inventory, usage and forecast requirements
  • Execute Grain Movement Orders
  • Manage and track all contract draw downs and grain storage handling facilities
  • Maintain relationships with grain trade suppliers and develop new business where possible
  • Evaluate and recommend suppliers/vendors
  • Provide market information relating to position and product quality relevant to raw materials to ensure wider team is across market trends and information.
About You
To be successful, you will have a close affinity to the Australian commodities sector, ideally relevant tertiary qualifications in an agricultural or economics degree as well as knowledge of grain contract and supply chain systems. You ideally will have 3+ years experience in the grains sector in a relevant role to give you an understanding of the major stakeholders and supply routes, with a high level of communication and attention to detail.

In return, you will be provided with a unique opportunity in the industry, working with a close knit, experienced team and an opportunity to work immediately in a commercially active role to contribute to a growing business. To confidentially discuss this role, please call Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701 or apply now via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Head of Supplementary Sourcing & Trading
job.description:
The Company:

E2E is Woolworths’ fully integrated, multi-channel end-to-end red meat supply chain business (Greenstock) spanning commercial, product development, and the supply chain, managing livestock, processing, manufacturing and strategic planning while maintaining total oversight to ensure excellence from farmer to customer.

For 40 years, Woolworths has cultivated direct, multi-generational partnerships with Australian farmers, also collaborating with processors and manufacturers to add value to their meat products. E2E plays a crucial role in bringing fresh meat to local Woolworths shelves 365 days of the year.

The Position:

Reporting to the GM, Strategy & Planning, the Head of Supplementary Sourcing and Trading is a key leadership role responsible for both architecting Woolworths’ overarching boxed meat sourcing strategy and driving hands-on, day to day purchasing execution.
  
In this pivotal position, you will drive commercial outcomes by leveraging deep market intelligence and by building high-value industry partnerships. You will partner across the value chain with planning, logistics, processing, manufacturing and quality to mitigate sourcing risks and unlock continuous commercial opportunities.  
  
Key responsibilities will include (but not limited to):
  • Supplier partnerships
  • Boxed Meat Quality and specifications
  • Boxed Meat Sourcing Strategy
  • Inventory Balancing and Logistics
  • Demand Consensus
  • Market Intelligence & Risk Mitigation
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Management
The Person:

We are keen to hear from you if you possess the following knowledge & experience, key skills & competencies:
  • Track record of architecting and executing overarching sourcing strategies, specifically dealing with agricultural commodities, fresh food or protein
  • Deep experience in prior roles requiring an intimate understanding of meat market cyclicality, livestock supply chains, buy/sell windows, and meat processing/quality specifications
  • Demonstrated large-scale Supply Chain & S & OP experience, balancing complex logistical trade-offs, network capacity and inventory optimisation    
  • Senior people leadership experience leading, coaching and developing cross functional teams, particularly operational and procurement teams
  • Commercial & strategic acumen with demonstrated ability to drive commercial advantage by leveraging deep market insights
  • High level problem solving with the ability to use data to solve complex problems in a team environment
  • Proven leadership experience to develop high performing teams and influence stakeholders
  • Exceptional relationship building skills to cultivate high value supplier networks, define overarching procurement strategies and drive vendor performance
  • High operational agility with a track record of taking ownership to deliver rapid outcomes  
This is an outstanding opportunity to join the Woolworths group with a shared purpose ‘to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow’. You will be supported in a dynamic, inclusive and empowering workplace with a culture of genuine care, a flexible approach to work, and future opportunities across the group to further grow your career and make a meaningful impact. 
   
For a confidential discussion or to learn more, please phone Mick Hay or David Jackson on 1300 380 701 or apply via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Retail Purchasing & Inventory Manager
job.description:
The Company

Our client has an exceptional reputation for connecting the best of Western Australian produce with discerning and passionate food-lovers. Financially well supported, with a strong growth trajectory and a commitment to local producers, the business now wishes to expand its leadership function in the very attractive South-West of Western Australia.
As the business continues to grow, an opportunity has arisen for an experienced Retail Purchasing & Inventory Manager to join the leadership team in a senior, high‑impact role.

The Role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Retail Purchasing & Inventory Manager is responsible for ensuring the right products are on the shelves at the right time across all locations. The role leads purchasing strategy, inventory management and supplier relationships for the Grocery Department, while providing leadership and support to retail supervisors and warehouse operations.
Critical to success in this role is the ability to build and maintain trusted and close relationships with growers, producers, and suppliers. This is a hands‑on leadership role that combines strategic buying, disciplined inventory control and strong operational execution within a fast‑paced, multi‑site retail environment.

Key Responsibilities

The role will lead strategic purchasing and sourcing activities across the grocery category, developing supplier relationships locally, nationally and internationally.
  • Negotiating pricing and trading terms, onboarding new suppliers and ensuring product ranging aligns with brand, quality and value objectives.
  • Overseeing inventory management across all store locations, balancing availability with waste reduction and margin performance.
  • Demand forecasting, stock optimisation, invoice accuracy, reconciliation and regular reporting on purchasing and inventory performance
  • Ensuring efficient stock flow from receipt through to store replenishment.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of purchasing, receiving and inventory systems and processes
As a senior leader, the role provides direction, mentoring and support to Retail Grocery Supervisors and associated teams, fostering consistency, accountability and a high‑performance culture across locations. The role also supports compliance with food safety, HACCP and OH&S requirements, ensuring audit‑ready systems and accurate documentation.

About You

To be considered for this opportunity, candidates will ideally possess the following:
  • Experience in purchasing, procurement or category management within food retail, grocery or a related sector
  • Excellent communication, relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Strong inventory management capability, including forecasting, margin control and waste reduction
  • Experience building and managing supplier relationships, including negotiation of pricing and service agreements
  • Commercial acumen with the ability to analyse purchasing data and drive financial performance
  • Leadership experience - with the ability to support, develop and motivate teams across multiple locations
Why This Role:

This role offers the opportunity to join a highly respected, values‑driven business with a strong growth trajectory. You will work closely with the CEO, influence key commercial outcomes and play a central role in shaping purchasing and inventory strategy for one of WA’s most iconic food retailers. In addition, this role may expand into a senior leadership position over time.
This is a key opportunity to use your background in retail, agribusiness, supply-chain and/or hospitality and to reach new heights in your leadership career. An attractive salary package will be offered and this includes car allowance and the opportunity to participate in the group’s incentive scheme.
The lifestyle benefits in the South-West cannot be overstated. With idyllic beaches, the beauty of the natural environment and access to modern social infrastructure (education, healthcare), never before has there been a better time to invest in or relocate to, the prized South-West of Western Australia.
Rental and relocation assistance can be negotiated and sponsorship will be considered for appropriately experienced candidates with retail and/or hospitality sector experience.

To Apply

To apply, please submit an updated cv and cover letter. For further information, please call Charles Linton on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Sales Manager

This is a hands‑on leadership role that combines sales strategy, people leadership, project oversight and market engagement, working closely with Operations, Finance and Design to deliver integrated solutions for customers.  You will be a key player in the Executive Leadership team, working closely with the CEO in taking ProWay on the exciting next phase of its development.

A stable, well‑established business with strong growth ambitions

job.title: Manager, Digital Agriculture & Artificial Intelligence
job.description:
The Company
Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC) is responsible for planning, investing, and overseeing research, development, and extension for the grains sector in Australia. They meet the evolving needs of grain growers with a vision to be regarded as the grower’s “RD&E department.”

GRDC believes it should be a valued grower asset that is open, transparent, and trusted - a true research partner who seeks to be agile and business like in their operations and improve productivity and profitability for growers.

The Opportunity
GRDC is seeking a Manager - Digital Agriculture & Artificial Intelligence to help shape the future application of digital and AI-enabled technologies across the Australian grains industry.

Working within the Enabling Technologies team, this role focuses on identifying practical opportunities where technology can improve grower decision-making, productivity and industry outcomes. Rather than developing technology directly, the role sits at the intersection of growers, researchers, commercial partners and innovation, helping connect industry challenges with scalable, practical solutions.

You will contribute to the development and management of RD&E investments spanning areas such as precision agriculture, remote sensing, automation, decision-support tools and broader digital agriculture systems. The role combines strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement and commercial awareness to help ensure technologies deliver meaningful value and practical adoption outcomes for Australian grain growers.

This involves:
  • Identifying and developing investment opportunities across digital agriculture and AI enabled systems
  • Developing business cases and investment proposals with clear return-on-investment rationale
  • Managing RD&E investments, including milestones, risk, budget and contract performance
  • Supporting adoption and path-to-market strategies for emerging technologies and project outputs
  • Building strong networks across industry, research, government and commercial stakeholders
  • Providing strategic input across broader GRDC investment portfolios
  • Supporting collaboration between researchers, growers and industry stakeholders
  • Contributing to technology deployment across agronomy, farming systems, biosecurity and crop improvement programs
About You
To be successful in this influential role you will have:
  • Experience within digital agriculture, agtech, precision agriculture, agricultural innovation or related sectors
  • Strong communication and relationship-building capability across researchers, growers, commercial partners and industry stakeholders
  • The ability to understand complex technical concepts and translate them into practical industry outcomes
  • Commercial awareness and the ability to assess opportunities through both technical and grower adoption lenses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, combined with curiosity and initiative
  • Experience contributing to RD&E projects, innovation programs or technology-focused initiatives within agriculture or adjacent sectors
  • A collaborative and adaptable working style
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in agriculture, plant science, science, engineering, data science or related disciplines
  • Experience within Australian broadacre or grains production systems (highly regarded)
Importantly, GRDC is seeking someone who combines curiosity, commercial thinking and strong stakeholder engagement with a genuine interest in the future of digital agriculture. You’ll play a key role in helping emerging technologies deliver practical value for Australian grain growers.

The role involves periodic travel to engage with growers, researchers and industry stakeholders across Australia’s grain-growing regions. Full Australian Working Rights (Citizenship or Permanent Residency) are required.

Why This Role
  • Help shape how digital agriculture is applied across the Australian grains industry
  • High-impact role bridging technology, industry and practical grower outcomes
  • Opportunity to grow into broader strategic leadership responsibilities over time
  • Collaborative team environment with strong industry exposure and flexibility
For confidential enquiries and a copy of the Position Description, please call Marcela Rocha Lima on 1300 380 701 or apply via rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Regional Sales Manager
job.description:

To be successful in this role, you will bring proven experience in sales leadership or senior sales within fuel, agribusiness, transport or another related regional industry. You will be a proactive, relationship-led operator who can work autonomously across a regional territory while staying connected to broader business priorities. Strong negotiation skills, sound computer literacy and a willingness to embrace technology and AI-enabled tools will also be important.

You will be comfortable travelling across Victoria, Southern New South Wales and South Australia as required for the role to support the ongoing growth of the business.

This is an opportunity to join a well-established, family-owned Australian business with a genuine connection to regional communities. An attractive salary package will be offered based on experience, including a company vehicle and staff fuel discount.

To Apply

job.title: Lead Production Agronomist
job.description:
The Company
GenTech Seeds is a recognised premium brand in Australian agribusiness and the exclusive producer and distributor of Pioneer® brand products in Australia.

The business works closely with growers to produce hybrid seed products suited to Australian farming systems, with a major seed manufacturing and distribution site based at Narromine in Central West NSW. The Narromine site brings together production, quality, field operations and distribution within a highly seasonal seed production environment.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Site Manager, this role will lead technical agronomy across commercial seed production in the Macquarie Valley.

The role is focused on corn through summer and canola through winter, with some involvement in sorghum, production trials and broader improvement projects. It combines crop agronomy, grower engagement and close collaboration with production, field and quality teams.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Manage seasonal agronomy programs across corn, canola and sorghum seed production.
  • Support growers with crop establishment, nutrition, irrigation, pest and disease decisions.
  • Monitor crop performance, seasonal risk, yield potential and seed quality requirements.
  • Contribute to production planning, trials and continuous improvement projects.
Seed production experience would be valuable, but the business is open to experienced agronomists from broader broadacre, row crop or production backgrounds who can bring technical depth, sound judgement and the right team approach.

About You
You are a practical agronomist who enjoys being close to the crop, the grower and the commercial outcome.

Experience in corn, canola or seed production would be valuable, although sound crop agronomy, good judgement and grower communication will be the key.

You will bring:
  • Agronomy experience across broadacre, irrigated or seed production systems.
  • Confidence working directly with growers, contractors and operational teams.
  • Sound judgement across crop performance, timing, quality and seasonal risk.
  • A hands-on, accountable approach with the ability to take ownership of a region.
Why This Role?
This is a genuine opportunity to step into a senior agronomy role with clear ownership of a key production region. You will be close to the decisions that affect crop performance, seed quality and grower outcomes, while working within a respected national business with strong systems, established grower relationships and a premium brand in the market.

For someone who enjoys technical agronomy, commercial production and building trust with growers, this role offers the chance to have real influence across a high-value seed production program.

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion, contact Marcela Rocha Lima on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: General Manager - Faulkner Farming
job.description:
The Company

Gunn Agri Partners was established in 2013 and provides agricultural investment and farm management services for Australian, North American and European investors. They adopt an industry-leading framework that integrates sustainability in the design and delivery of their strategies and a mandate to transparently report against investor’s target outcomes.

Focusing on mixed farming enterprises and natural asset development, they manage a ~$1.05B portfolio of investment assets across various platforms. By lifting productivity and optimising land use, they integrate a sustainable enterprise mix of cropping, grazing and biodiversity conservation.

This portfolio, Faulkner Farming, also known as the Transforming Farming Platform, established in 2021, consists of four aggregations spread across NSW and South Australia, comprising 21kha. They are well resourced to meet targets, and operate in a fluid and quick decision environment, empowering the GM with clear delegation. Modern machinery utilising the latest hi tech, ensures a reliable fleet.

The Opportunity

The position of General Manager – Faulkner Farming, will lead the team with responsibility for overall performance of the business reporting to the Managing Directors and the Faulkner Farming Board.

The role will be responsible for all aspects of business and farm performance including operations productivity, profitability and sustainability, financial management and reporting, statutory requirements, compliance and control, external liaison and process improvement.

You will be a role model in the core values of the business – including integrity, teamwork and community commitment. A comprehensive back office provides support for the General Manager and the Faulkner Farming business.

Specifically, this involves:
  • leading and managing farm aggregation managers and their teams
  • driving workplace health and safety and building a robust safety culture
  • setting and managing budgets and forecasts,
  • managing natural capital assets,
  • implementing the sustainability policy of the businesses,
  • oversee all capital expenditure programs, including the implementation of sustainability strategies.
About You

To be successful in this hands-on yet strategic role you will have the following capabilities:
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in managing agricultural operations.
  • Strong knowledge of agricultural production, sustainability practices, and business processes.
  • Appreciation of natural capital.
  • Ideally experience working in a corporate environment.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Agriculture or Business Management preferred
  
Being a self-starter, you are motivated with the ability to work towards deadlines. With a strong team orientation, you are willing to work with others to achieve results.

Why This Role

This portfolio is an exciting role as the business is establishing its core DNA and culture and open to a leader to put your stamp on the business and take it to the next level. You might be a well experienced GM or have experience managing a couple of Farm Managers and ready to step up to GM.

Whilst Tamworth would be an ideal base for this role, there is flexibility to be located anywhere along the eastern seaboard, provided there is convenient access to a well-connected airport.

How to Apply: 
For a confidential discussion, contact AL Kellaway on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Regional Manager - Goondiwindi
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a leader in providing science based, agricultural field research services, conducting trials in the major broadacre and horticultural cropping regions of Australia. A new role has been created for a Regional Manager - Goondiwindi to manage an area of the northern business research unit, overseeing the field operations and logistics in the broadacre regions of Northern NSW, Sth West QLD and Central QLD.

job.title: Manager National Variety Trial (NVT) - Operations, Partnerships, & Strategy
job.description:
The Company

Grains Research and Development Corporation (GRDC) is responsible for planning, investing, and overseeing research, development, and extension for the grains sector in Australia. They meet the evolving needs of grain growers with a vision to be regarded as the grower’s “RD&E department.” GRDC believes it should be a valued grower asset that is open, transparent, and trusted - a true partner who seeks to be agile and business like in their operations and improve productivity and profitability for growers.

The Opportunity

GRDC is seeking a Manager - National Variety Trial – Operations, Partnerships, & Strategy, a key role supporting the world renowned NVT program.  

The National Variety Trials (NVT) program is one of GRDC’s highest profile projects. Established in 2005 it is solely managed and funded by GRDC on behalf of Australian grain growers. Since inception, the NVT program has expanded to become the largest coordinated variety trial network in the world with 9 out of 10 Australian grain growers using NVT information. The program assists Australian grain growers and their advisors in varietal decision making by providing information on commercially available grain varieties, including comparisons of yield performance, disease resistance and grain quality.

An exceptional opportunity to work in a collaborative and passionate team by working closely across GRDC and externally to help shape the NVT program. You will be responsible for the ongoing success and evolution of the NVT by overseeing several key national components of the program as listed in the PD.

The team has a flexible mindset, and your specific responsibilities will be dependent on your expertise, experience, and interests you bring to the GRDC. The successful candidate will work within the NVT national team alongside 3 established and experienced managers delivering a wide range of responsibilities.
  • NVT systems management: responsible for all aspects of NVT's Systems
  • NVT collaborative partnerships management: responsible for administration of all elements of NVT partnerships to increase the benefit the NVT delivers for the Australian grains industry
  • NVT strategy and innovation management: responsible for NVT strategy and innovation for the continuous improvement of the program
  • NVT breeder operations management: responsible for managing all aspects of NVT’s breeder focussed operations
  
GRDC seeks candidates that have capability and experience across ideally two or more of the following disciplines as follows:

  • IT Systems Management – Management and continuous improvement of digital platforms, databases and reporting systems to support efficient program delivery and stakeholder engagement.
  • Pest & Disease Pathology Ratings – Oversight or delivery of pest and disease pathology programs.
  • Stakeholder Management – Relationship management of a wide range of stakeholders including grower groups, agri-political groups, industry bodies, breeding.
  • Trial Operations Management – Management, development, and improvement of trial and seed production programs.
  • Analytics Management – Analytics, statistical innovation, and reporting to drive data-driven decision making for growers.
  • Strategy and Innovation Management – Development and implementation of strategies, policies and improvement initiatives that enhance large program effectiveness and future performance.
  • Partnerships Management – Negotiation and management of industry and business partnerships, and commercial agreements that increase value for GRDC, growers, and the broader grains industry.
About You

To be successful in this role you will have:
  • Experience in contract, project or program management within a relevant industry, with 5+ years' experience highly desirable
  • Background in one or more relevant disciplines, such as digital systems and platform management, crop research, plant breeding, statistics and data analytics, trial management, agronomy, stakeholder account management, or project management.
  • Ability to manage complex programs, projects or operational activities involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities and time-critical deliverables.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining productive relationships with industry participants, service providers, researchers, commercial partners or other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated skill in identifying opportunities for process improvement, innovation and efficiency, and leading initiatives that deliver measurable benefits.
  • Agriculture science qualifications
  • Experience in grains and pulse trials
  • Ability to commercially analyse and assess a R&D project
  • Direct experience in either cereals, pulses or oilseeds will be highly regarded
  • Demonstrated ability as a genuine team player, willing to work proactively within a dynamic team
  • Exceptional project management skills
  • Key stakeholder engagement and collaboration with breeders, growers and industry with a commercial focus
  • Ability to influence and communicate technical information clearly to diverse audiences
Why This Role

GRDC plays a vital role in the grains sector, and this is a genuine opportunity to participate in the highly regarded NVT program. They aim to assist growers and advisors in varietal decision making and strive to generate credible information that is accurate, consistent, independent, timely and locally relevant.

For confidential enquiries and a copy of the Position Description, please phone Ryan Hoiberg or David Jackson on 1300 380 701 or apply via rimfireresources.com.au.

job.title: Technical Development Manager - Southern Region
job.description:
The Company

LongReach Plant Breeders, a joint venture between Advanta Seeds and Syngenta, is one of Australia’s leading wheat breeding and commercialisation companies. For more than a quarter of a century, the business has conducted research, developed new products and introduced technologies that ultimately improve grower profitability.

With a strong reputation in the Australian grains industry, LongReach continues to build a competitive wheat portfolio through market-led breeding, technical development and commercial partnerships. The business is focused on delivering varieties that meet grower needs, perform in Australian farming systems and support continued growth across the market.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Commercial Manager, this role will manage LongReach’s product development and advanced line commercialisation across the Southern Region. It is a highly market-facing technical role, supporting the transfer of knowledge between the wheat breeding program, growers, agronomists, advisers and broader industry stakeholders.

The role will ensure new wheat varieties, agronomic practices and research outcomes are effectively evaluated, communicated and adopted across farming systems. Just as importantly, it will bring market, technical and grower feedback back into the breeding program to help shape pipeline and portfolio decisions.

Key areas of focus include:
  • Coordinating product development trials, demonstration sites and variety evaluation activity
  • Translating breeding and research outcomes into practical information for growers and advisers
  • Delivering field days, workshops, technical updates and industry presentations
  • Building relationships with growers, agronomists, consultants, seed companies and industry bodies
  • Supporting product advancement, variety release and commercialisation planning
  • Providing technical, market and farming system feedback to breeders and the commercial team
This position will also play an important role in LongReach’s engagement with the NVT program, grower groups, retail agronomy networks, independent agronomists and key industry events across South Australia and Victoria.

About You

We are seeking a practical, technically strong and relationship-driven grains professional who brings:
  • 5+ years’ experience in cereal agronomy, broadacre cropping or a related technical environment
  • A graduate qualification in agriculture, agronomy or a related discipline
  • Strong knowledge of Southern Region farming systems across South Australia and Victoria
  • Experience in field agronomics, cereal farming methods, disease assessment and trial evaluation
  • An understanding of plant breeding operations, genetics and selection methodologies
  • Strong communication, networking and stakeholder engagement skills
  • The ability to work independently, organise field activity and travel widely across cropping regions
Most importantly, you will be self-motivated, commercially aware and confident working with growers, advisers, researchers and internal teams to turn technical insight into practical value in the paddock.

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to join LongReach Plant Breeders in a role that aligns closely to the science, the market and the grower. You will have the chance to influence how new wheat varieties are evaluated, positioned, released and adopted across one of Australia’s most important grain-growing regions.

If you are a technically capable grains professional who enjoys working closely alongside  growers, advisers and industry, we would love to hear from you. For a confidential discussion, contact Ryan Hoiberg on 1300 380 701. Applications via www.rimfireresources.com.au

job.title: Senior Asset Manager (GIS)
job.description:
The Company
Our client, Murray Irrigation, is seeking a Senior Asset Officer (GIS) to lead the management, data integrity, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s Asset Management System (AMS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). This role drives best-practice spatial data governance, provides expert technical guidance, and delivers strategic analysis to underpin asset lifecycle decision-making across the organisation.
Murray Irrigation is the largest private irrigation water delivery company in Australia, formed as an unlisted public company in March 1995 when the NSW Government privatised its Murray Irrigation area and districts. The company's irrigators are also shareholders and include 2,100 landholdings across 724,000 hectares in the Southern Riverina. 
The Opportunity
Reporting to the Strategic Asset Manager, this role offers flexible working arrangements (onsite, remote, or hybrid, with a minimum requirement of 3 days per month on site). The role acts as the technical authority on GIS and asset data matters, with key responsibilities including:
  • Leading the ongoing management, enhancement, and governance of AMS and GIS systems to ensure high availability, data quality, and access control.
  • Leading the GIS workstream for new Asset Management System implementations, including designing, building, and maintaining integrations between GIS platforms and enterprise systems.
  • Designing, building, and maintaining a suite of high-quality web maps, dashboards, and field collection applications (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, Field Maps, Survey123) to drive capability across field and operational teams.
  • Automating spatial data workflows, ETL processes, and repetitive tasks using scripting tools such as Python, Arcade, FME, or equivalent.
  • Conducting advanced spatial analysis, geographic modelling, and scenario analysis to support capital planning, asset replacement schedules, and resource allocation.
  • Leading data quality improvement programs, establishing QA/QC processes, and governing spatial data collection standards for field operations.
  • Providing technical guidance, training, and support across business units to build organisational capability in spatial systems and asset data tools.
About You
The ideal candidate will be a forward-thinking spatial specialist with strong technical expertise in enterprise GIS platforms, spatial data governance, and system integrations. To be successful in this role, you will have the following experience and attributes:
  • Tertiary qualifications in GIS, Spatial Science, Surveying, or a related field combined with substantial experience in a senior or specialist enterprise GIS role.
  • Extensive experience in the administration, architecture, and strategic customisation of the full ESRI product suite (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, ESRI Web Apps, Field Maps, Survey123).
  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise data management systems, system administration, configuration, and GIS–enterprise system integrations.
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Arcade, FME, or equivalent to automate spatial workflows and data pipelines.
  • Demonstrated expertise in designing, managing, and improving field data collection apps and user workflows for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Highly developed written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts for senior leadership and operational teams.
  • Strong project leadership skills, with the ability to work autonomously, exercise sound professional judgment, and drive continuous improvement.
Why This Role
Unique opportunity to drive spatial innovation and lead the enterprise GIS function for a major regional water infrastructure provider. To enquire about this role, please phone Charles MacCallum on 1300 380 701 for a confidential conversation. Or apply online with a tailored cover letter and resume.
